items.Sentence: Reclaimable flows will go through existing preliminary, primary, and secondary (trickling filter solids contact) treatment before being pumped to GWRS.
Build a 6 MG equalization storage tank at Plant No. 2 to store secondary effluent during peak day flows and be returned to the system during low flow periods to maintain a constant flow to the GWRS.
After the GWRS Final Expansion, the activated sludge treatment process will treat only SARI and side-stream flows.
Convert the unused 66-inch gravity reinforced concrete pipeline into a pressure pipeline using a trenchless pipe repair method, to convey the effluent pump station discharge.
